subject: Fix ObjectDisposedException when closing a connection tab
body:
Fix ObjectDisposedException when closing a connection tab

ProtocolBase.Close() runs CloseBG on a background thread, which fires
ClosedEvent -> ConnectionWindow.Prot_Event_Closed. The existing
IsDisposed/Disposing guard there only checks at entry: if the user
closes the tab/window between that check and Invoke(), Invoke() throws
ObjectDisposedException on the now-disposed ConnectionWindow.

Add an IsHandleCreated check, wrap the Invoke in try/catch for
ObjectDisposedException/InvalidOperationException, and re-check
tabPage.IsDisposed inside the marshaled action itself.

triage.rationale: Closes TOCTOU race in Prot_Event_Closed Invoke; our guards (IsDisposed check) exist but not the try/catch + marshaled re-check. Small defensive win; code diverged.

votes.concern: Already implemented; the donor's Disposing guard can skip protocolClose and revive the white-tab close failure fixed in this fork.
votes.reason: Current HandleProtocolClosed already has stronger handle, marshaling, disposal-race, and close guards, so this commit offers no unique value and conflicts with intentional semantics.

votes.concern: May already exist here; broad InvalidOperationException catch could hide real bugs
votes.reason: Small race fix on tab close; matches protocol stability goals; easy to verify

votes.concern: Redundant — our HandleProtocolClosed already guards IsHandleCreated, catches ObjectDisposedException/InvalidOperationException via BeginInvoke.
votes.reason: Fork diverged: same race already fixed better (non-blocking BeginInvoke re-marshal, ConnectionWindow.cs:2223-2246). Import adds nothing, code no longer matches.
